svg.title: For Developers
svg.desc: Is my NEAR code current? What NEAR removed, deprecated or renamed, read from its own docs, releases and registries, with the fix and the date. Tools: check_code, check_deprecation, resolve_package, get_breaking_changes, explain_error, find_known_issues, find_code_examples, get_standard, get_protocol_status, search, semantic_search, get_doc.
svg.text: renamed, read from its own docs,
